meta.mechanism: small interfering RNA against LPA (apolipoprotein(a)) mRNA; reduces hepatic Lp(a) synthesis
meta.indication: secondary prevention of CHD death, MI or urgent coronary revascularization in ASCVD (prior MI and/or PCI plus >=1 risk factor) with Lp(a) >= 200 nmol/L

expected_readout.value: 2028-03-31 (registry estimated primary completion); topline readout timing conflicts across sources
expected_readout.location: Registry statusModule: primaryCompletionDate 2028-03-31 (ESTIMATED), last update posted 2026-02-27
expected_readout.note: Registry field, not a quotable sentence. Conflicts: BioSpace (S6, 2026-09-08) says 'slated for a topline readout in 2028'; Curr Atheroscler Rep review (S7, 2026-08-13) says 'estimated to be completed in December 2026, with results anticipated in 2027' citing the registry (apparently an older registry version); Family Heart Foundation page (S8, updated 2026-03-20) says 'completion is expected in March 2028'. Event-driven trial; no Amgen guidance on topline timing found.

n_randomized.note: Registry field (actual enrollment; status ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING). Amgen CSO Jay Bradner on Q2 2026 call (S5, secondary transcript): '7,297 patients have been enrolled in record time.'

median_followup.note: NOT FOUND: trial ongoing; registry time frame for primary outcome is 'Approximately 5 years'. Start 2022-12-14.

primary_endpoint.value: time to CHD death, myocardial infarction, or urgent coronary revascularization, whichever occurs first
primary_endpoint.quote: Time to CHD death, myocardial infarction, or urgent coronary revascularization, whichever occurs first
primary_endpoint.note: Coronary 3-point endpoint; excludes stroke. Bradner (S5, secondary transcript): 'We focused on 3-point MACE after extensive human genetics and population science analysis indicated to us that the association of ischemic stroke and Lp(a) elevation was not as compelling as other cardiac-specific cardiovascular endpoints.'

inclusion_key_criteria.value: age 18-85; Lp(a) >= 200 nmol/L at screening; ASCVD = history of MI (presumed type 1) and/or PCI plus >=1 additional risk factor
inclusion_key_criteria.note: Registry also: 'Coronary revascularization with percutaneous coronary intervention AND at least 1 additional risk factor.' Excludes prior Lp(a)-targeted RNA therapy and apheresis.

planned_events.note: NOT FOUND: no design/rationale paper or public statistical plan located (Europe PMC, PubMed, Amgen releases, SEC 8-Ks).

alpha.note: NOT FOUND. Interim analyses were asked about on the Q2 2026 call (S5) but no plan was disclosed in the transcript summary obtained.

stopped_early.note: Ongoing; not stopped as of registry update 2026-02-27.

dose_regimen.quote: injections of olpasiran or placebo every 12 weeks
dose_regimen.note: Dose NOT FOUND in registry (arms say only 'subcutaneous injection'). Every-12-weeks interval from patient-advocacy page (S8) and Amgen 'quarterly dosing' remark (S5); both secondary.

baseline.note: NOT FOUND for OCEAN(a)-Outcomes. Entry threshold >= 200 nmol/L (S1). Phase 2 OCEAN(a)-DOSE (entry >150 nmol/L) median baseline 260.3 nmol/L (S2).

baseline.quote: Among the 281 enrolled patients, the median concentration of lipoprotein(a) at baseline was 260.3 nmol per liter, and the median concentration of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol was 67.5 mg per deciliter.
the median concentration of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol was 67.5 mg per deciliter

biomarker_effects.method: placebo-adjusted mean percent change from baseline (assay not stated in abstract)
biomarker_effects.quote: resulting in placebo-adjusted mean percent changes of -70.5% with the 10-mg dose, -97.4% with the 75-mg dose, -101.1% with the 225-mg dose administered every 12 weeks, and -100.5% with the 225-mg dose administered every 24 weeks

biomarker_effects.method: placebo-adjusted mean percent change from baseline
biomarker_effects.quote: -101.1% with the 225-mg dose administered every 12 weeks
biomarker_effects.note: 225 mg every 12 weeks. Values beyond -100% reflect placebo adjustment (placebo +3.6%).

biomarker_effects.method: placebo-adjusted mean percent change from baseline
placebo-adjusted mean percent change from baseline
biomarker_effects.quote: -100.5% with the 225-mg dose administered every 24 weeks

safety_signals.value: phase 2: adverse event incidence similar across groups; most common drug-related AE injection-site reactions (primarily pain)
safety_signals.quote: The most common olpasiran-related adverse events were injection-site reactions, primarily pain.

genetics.finding: LPA variants (rs10455872, rs3798220) raise Lp(a) and coronary disease risk; association abolished after adjusting for Lp(a)
genetics.quote: Our findings provide support for a causal role of Lp(a) lipoprotein in coronary disease.

genetics.finding: MR: CHD benefit proportional to absolute Lp(a) reduction; ~101.5 mg/dL lowering equivalent to 1 mmol/L LDL-C
genetics.effect: OR 0.942 (0.933-0.951) per 10 mg/dL lower genetically predicted Lp(a)
genetics.quote: Large absolute reductions in Lp(a) of approximately 100 mg/dL may be required to produce a clinically meaningful reduction in the risk of CHD similar in magnitude to what can be achieved by lowering LDL-C level by 38.67 mg/dL (ie, 1 mmol/L).

genetics.finding: Lp(a)-GWAS-Consortium MR: 65.7 mg/dL lowering required to match 38.67 mg/dL LDL-C lowering
genetics.quote: This mendelian randomization analysis estimated a required Lp(a)-lowering effect size of 65.7 mg/dL to reach the same effect as a 38.67-mg/dL lowering of LDL-C.

consensus_explanation.summary: Not applicable: forecast case, outcome pending. Context for forecasters: the first Lp(a)-lowering CVOT (Lp(a)HORIZON, pelacarsen, ASO) missed its primary endpoint on 2026-09-04 (S12). Amgen's pre-readout differentiation (Q2 2026 call, 2026-08-04, S5): ~95% vs ~70% Lp(a) lowering, Lp(a) >= 200 nmol/L entry (higher risk), coronary 3-point endpoint excluding stroke. No official Amgen statement after the pelacarsen failure was found.

pre_readout.note: Forecast case: no readout yet. Lists key facts public as of 2026-10-05.
available_before_readout: Burgess 2018 JAMA Cardiol MR, ~100 mg/dL needed (S10, 2018-07-01)
Lamina 2019 JAMA Cardiol MR, 65.7 mg/dL needed (S11, 2019-06-01)

OCEAN(a)-DOSE phase 2: -97.4% (75 mg Q12W), -101.1% (225 mg Q12W) at week 36; median baseline 260.3 nmol/L (S2, 2022-11-06)
Amgen Q2 2026 call: design rationale, 95% vs 70% comparison (S5, 2026-08-04)

access_summary.note: Registry: N, primary endpoint, Lp(a) threshold, primary completion date. Abstract only (NEJM 2022): phase 2 Lp(a) changes at 4 doses and baseline median Lp(a). Not found: planned events, assumed RRR, power, alpha, phase 3 dose, phase 3 baseline Lp(a). Dosing interval and readout statements available only from secondary sources.

open_questions: Expected readout conflict: registry estimated primary completion 2028-03-31 (S1, updated 2026-02-27) and BioSpace 'topline readout in 2028' (S6) vs review (S7) 'estimated to be completed in December 2026, with results anticipated in 2027' (likely an older registry version; CT.gov version history API returned 403, so the change could not be confirmed).

Planned event count, assumed RRR, power and alpha: no design paper or public SAP found. Bradner said the 3-point endpoint 'should not change the event rate' in Amgen's modeling (secondary summary of S5), but no number was given.
Phase 3 olpasiran dose not disclosed in registry; 'every 12 weeks' only from secondary sources (S8; Amgen 'quarterly dosing' in S5).
Amgen's Q2 2026 8-K (S3) mentions OCEAN(a)-Outcomes only as 'ongoing'; no official Amgen statement on the pelacarsen failure found (Morningstar/TheStreet analyst pieces paywalled or 403).
Bradner's comparison '95% Lp(a) reduction compared to, say, 70% with that molecule' (S5) is from a third-party transcript; the official Amgen transcript PDF (investors.amgen.com) returned 403.
Baseline Lp(a) and LDL-C of the phase 3 cohort not public.
